grammar_distinctions_required_by_skl: K must remain distinct from P: SKL02 contains internal transformation processes that occupy frozen old-P coordinates but have no interface intervention/probe role; reverse projection maps their change topology to K.
P must be directional: SKL01/03/04/05 instantiate P_in; SKL01/03/04/05/06 instantiate P_out; SKL02 instantiates neither.
C must remain narrower than generic difficulty/condition: only SKL01, SKL02 and SKL04 have frozen resource_C support.
Q must remain criterion-relative and non-necessarily-scalar: SKL03 uses a baseline relation-shift criterion; SKL05 uses a discrimination threshold.
Pi must remain non-physical and operationally grounded: SKL06 supplies a probe-relative segmentation/grouping Pi.
O must permit multiple non-equivalent traces under different P_out operations: SKL04 separates performance evidence from reported awareness.
Grammar roles need not be disjoint at the claim-node level: SKL05 discrimination_threshold is an O trace and, via frozen criterion_Q/threshold control, also induces Q.
Persistence requires explicit carry/transport semantics rather than universal K = identity: frozen persistence occurs in SKL01, SKL02 and SKL05 only.
residual_structures_not_first_class_in_g: Explicit null/no-significant-effect assertions (SKL03 r9; SKL04 r8; SKL06 r4).
Epistemic non-entailment or source-interpretation status (SKL03 r8; SKL05 r8; SKL06 r9).
Qualified similarity and explicit model rejection/open alternatives (SKL04 r11; SKL06 r10).
possible_compression_or_derived_feature_: Frozen S -> X is supported in all six claims.
Old-P internal process nodes in SKL02 compress into K rather than interface P.
Performance-versus-awareness O kinds in SKL04 can remain one O family distinguished by P_out topology.
Resource/load/capacity structure compresses into C only in SKL01/02/04.
Baseline-shift and threshold criteria compress into generalized Q in SKL03/05.
Operational grouped representation in SKL06 compresses into Pi without physical-boundary semantics.
Persistence in SKL01/02/05 is a carry/transport candidate; identity K is not licensed.
potential_threats_to_grammar_v0: Lossless claim-language preservation needs a relation-annotation layer for null polarity, epistemic status, qualified similarity and open-alternative/model-rejection statements. These residuals do not presently require a ninth top-level cognitive role.

The Lean carrier supplies Pin/Pout/Part fields globally. Claims with scientifically ABSENT P or Pi must be representable by degenerate/technical carriers without treating those implementation values as source-supported role instantiations.
The Lean K signature accepts Pin; SKL02 shows that the scientific role inventory must allow K with P_in absent. A technical singleton Pin may be used only as plumbing, never as evidence.
Role overlap must be permitted: SKL05 supplies an observable threshold that is simultaneously O evidence and Q-inducing criterion structure.

counterexample_to_grammar_v0.statement: No SKL claim requires an additional top-level role beyond Grammar v0 on the frozen lane. SKL03-SKL06 do expose non-role relation-semantic residuals, so Grammar v0 should not yet be described as a lossless full claim language.
